environment: Firebase emulators + LiveKit Cloud QA; synthetic media/adult identities

checks.name: Three separate authenticated adult browser sessions
Instructor creates an adult room and learners enroll through its private invitation
A learner and an outsider cannot start the class or access its private state
Firestore emulator: pre-existing minor membership is denied by the adult video pilot
Firestore emulator: closing while a credential is signed fences the response and revokes its ledger entry
Firestore emulator: provider revocation failure keeps closing retryable and blocks new credentials
Firestore emulator: lifecycle reconciliation ends an expired class and its issued credentials
Adversarial: another coach and body-supplied role cannot acquire owner powers across rooms
Adversarial: missing, expired and minor membership cannot be replaced by client-supplied eligibility
Adversarial: a valid owner cannot use a session identifier belonging to another room
Adversarial: concurrent learner joins reserve an instructor seat and never exceed class capacity
Adversarial: withdrawing membership during credential signing prevents a late token response
Adversarial: removing a learner during signing blocks both the pending response and future tokens
Adversarial: token rate limits and closed-room checks remain server-authoritative
Adversarial: uncertain provider startup is retryable on the same class, without duplicate sessions
Instructor starts class, two learners join with devices off, all see three participants
Real Cloud media: synthetic camera is decoded in both learner browsers and audio plays
Only the instructor can share a screen; learner grants forbid screen/data/admin permissions
Adversarial browser: a malformed live snapshot disconnects safely and recovery restores the class
Instructor moves update both shared boards without scrolling the mobile learner
Adversarial browser: a delayed join response cannot reopen media after navigating away
A learner leaves and rejoins the same Cloud class with its latest board and video
Instructor mutes a learner through the authenticated server control
Responsive desktop/mobile classroom has no horizontal overflow or serious accessibility violations
Removed learner disconnects, cannot obtain another token, and cannot replay the cached Cloud token
Ending the class disconnects the remaining learner and rejects cached learner/instructor tokens
A new class has a distinct session; withdrawal revokes media and room closure ends instructor media
No unhandled browser exceptions
